tweet.text:
If you have concrete suggestions here I could pass them on! METR takes its independence very seriously.

E.g. one thing I have discussed with them is whether they should (in as far as possible) refuse to accept free API credits from the labs.

I believe METR see the main limitation to their independence currently as needing to maintain access with the labs (but it is hard to imagine this changing with regulation)
